summary: Learn practical precision agriculture and farm data management skills in 5 days. Design maps, workflows, and KPIs to improve yields and input efficiency.
lede: GNSS provides positioning for precision agriculture, supporting field guidance and georeferenced farm data. For agriculture professionals managing fields, machinery, or farm records, this training addresses how to organize farm data and use it for practical decisions. You’ll practice mapping field boundaries with GIS, analyzing soil and yield data, and drafting variable-rate prescriptions.
audienceIntro: This training is tailored for agriculture professionals who already manage fields, data, or technology and now need to integrate precision tools with structured farm data management.
audience: Irrigation Manager using sensor and satellite data
modules: GPS, GNSS, and Field Mapping with GIS
Sensors, Remote Sensing, and Crop Monitoring Data
Yield, Soil, and Zone Analysis with Farm Data
Variable Rate Application Planning and Evaluation
Farm Management Information Systems (FMIS) in Practice
Analytics, Dashboards, and AI-Ready Farm Data
prerequisites: This is an intermediate-level course. You should have: (1) working knowledge of crop production or farm operations, (2) basic familiarity with spreadsheets such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and (3) prior exposure to GPS-guided equipment, mapping tools, or digital farm records, even if informal. No coding or advanced statistics are required. You will benefit if you can bring sample field data, soil test reports, or machine logs from your context, subject to data confidentiality policies.
